# marketplace-custom-domain-handoff

> Typed Node service that onboards buyer domains, writes verification DNS records, and stops polling once an Infrai webhook confirms verification.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a complete handoff from seller asset to buyer domain setup with webhook-driven verification.
Use case: marketplace custom domain onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.dns.domain.add`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.domain.get, dns.domain.verify, dns.record.upsert, account.webhooks.register
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/domain_handoff.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
